inputs.modified_text: Tens of thousands were marched through central London on Saturday under the banner of opposing the far right, in a rally coordinated by hundreds of groups. The timing is hard to ignore: six months after a major far-right demonstration and just weeks before key local elections. Whatever the public-facing message, this looks like a carefully staged show of force by institutions and campaign networks seeking to shape the political climate before voters go to the polls.
